paper.title_en: Torsion balances as operational probes of semiclassical gravity: Matched-filter bounds, torque-diffusion constraints, and quantum-noise benchmarks
paper.abstract_en: Calibrated torsion-balance spectra constrain deterministic and stochastic deviations from standard Newtonian gravity. Using one-sided spectra, we derive a calibrated angle-equivalent noise budget and finite-time matched-filter/Cramér-Rao bounds for known torque templates. For stochastic models, subtracting the calibrated standard noise budget (thermal, Newtonian, environmental, imprecision, backaction) from the observed angle spectrum yields a residual spectrum, convertible to an equivalent residual torque spectrum via calibrated torsional susceptibility. This bounds additional stationary stochastic torque noise. This frequency-resolved bound compresses to a single torque-diffusion coefficient, $D_τ$, only in the Markovian white-noise limit; non-Markovian or colored models require the full residual spectrum. Page--Geilker branch discrimination and Fedida-Kent mixture-equivalence tests address distinct physical questions, but upon projection onto torque templates, both reduce to the same statistical matched-filter discrimination problem. For a room-temperature Cavendish benchmark, resonant thermal angle ASD is $1.36\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{rad}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$, while measurement-added SQL is $3.25\times10^{-12}\,\mathrm{rad}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$. For the Yan \emph{et al.} search, the reported $0.3\,μ\mathrm{rad}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ sensitivity at $2.5\,\mathrm{mHz}$ yields a conservative bound $D_τ\lesssim 2.4\times10^{-23}\,\mathrm{N^2\,m^2\,s}$, assuming white torque noise. These formulations provide an interface linking calibrated torsion-balance data, deterministic tests, and stochastic semiclassical-gravity searches, without asserting a direct test of the full relativistic semiclassical Einstein equation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出将扭秤数据与半经典引力理论对接的具体方法，包括噪声预算、匹配滤波界限及对Page-Geilker等实验的判别，具有理论深度和实验关联性。
decision.title_zh: 扭秤作为半经典引力的操作探针：匹配滤波界限、扭矩扩散约束和量子噪声基准
decision.abstract_zh: 校准的扭秤谱约束了标准牛顿引力的确定性和随机偏差。利用单边谱，我们推导了校准的角度等效噪声预算，以及已知扭矩模板的有限时间匹配滤波/Cramér-Rao界限。对于随机模型，从观测到的角度谱中减去校准的标准噪声预算（热、牛顿、环境、不精确性、反作用）得到残差谱，通过校准的扭转磁化率可转换为等效的残余扭矩谱。这限制了额外的平稳随机扭矩噪声。只有在下马尔可夫白噪声极限下，这种频率分辨界限才能压缩为单扭矩扩散系数 $D_τ$；非马尔可夫或有色模型需要完整的残差谱。Page--Geilker分支判别和Fedida-Kent混合等价检验针对不同的物理问题，但投影到扭矩模板后，两者都归结为相同的统计匹配滤波判别问题。对于室温卡文迪什基准，共振热角度ASD为 $1.36\times10^{-4}\mathrm{rad}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$，而测量附加SQL为 $3.25\times10^{-12}\mathrm{rad}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$。对于Yan \emph{et al.}的搜索，报告的 $0.3μ\mathrm{rad}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ 在 $2.5\mathrm{mHz}$ 的灵敏度，假设白扭矩噪声，给出了保守界限 $D_τ\lesssim 2.4\times10^{-23}\mathrm{N^2\,m^2\,s}$。这些公式提供了一个接口，将校准的扭秤数据、确定性测试和随机半经典引力搜索连接起来，而不主张对完整相对论性半经典爱因斯坦方程的直接测试。
